TITAN.attchmntText: Titan Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Earnings Call Transcripts
TITAN.voiceSummary: Titan Company Limited filed a notice with BSE and NSE on 11th November 2026 regarding the transcript of the Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on 5th November 2026. The transcript discusses unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. Management reported consolidated growth driven by innovation. Titan Jewellery recorded a customs duty gain of Rs. 490 crores, while CaratLane recorded Rs. 46 crores. Normalized margins were stated as 11.1% for Titan Jewellery and 11.7% after adjusting for mark-to-market reversals. A fair value adjustment of Rs. 671 crores was recognized on the Damas acquisition liability. Management noted festive season trends showed strong starts and endings with softness in between due to gold price volatility. Investment buying remained soft, while studded jewellery demand was strong. Lower caratage jewellery adoption continues as a strategic long-term initiative. The board has approved raising Rs. 2,500 crores for replenishing existing borrowing.

BSE.attchmntText: BSE Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
BSE.voiceSummary: BSE Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 4, 2026. Consolidated revenues for H1 FY27 stood at Rs. 3,257 crores, up 49% from Rs. 2,184 crores. Net profit attributable to shareholders reached Rs. 1,680 crores, a 53% increase from Rs. 1,095 crores. Operational revenues grew 48% to Rs. 2,999 crores. Transaction charges rose 60% to Rs. 2,456 crores. Operating EBITDA increased 55% to Rs. 2,019 crores. Investor accounts on BSE reached 26.8 crores. The mutual fund industry assets under management hit Rs. 82.64 lakh crores as of September 2026. BSE SME crossed 800 listed companies in October 2026. Equity cash segment recorded a highest quarterly average daily turnover of Rs. 10,494 crores in Q2 FY27. Index options premium ADTV reached Rs. 35,481 crores in October 2026.

JSWSTEEL.attchmntText: JSW Steel Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 11, 2026, titled "JSW Steel reports Consolidated Crude Steel Production of  25.73 Lakh Tonnes for October 2026"
JSWSTEEL.voiceSummary: JSW Steel reported consolidated crude steel production of 25.73 Lakh Tonnes for October 2026, representing a 19% year-on-year growth. Indian operations contributed 24.86 Lakh Tonnes, while JSW Steel USA Ohio contributed 0.87 Lakh Tonnes. Capacity utilization for Indian operations was 92%. Previous year figures have been adjusted to exclude the Bhushan Power and Steel Limited steel business undertaking transferred to JSW-JFE Steel Limited in March 2026. The company is the flagship business of the JSW Group and aims to expand its combined crude steel capacity to 54.8 MTPA over the next four years.

HAL.attchmntText: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited has informed the Exchange about Credit Rating- withdrawal
HAL.voiceSummary: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited has withdrawn its credit ratings from ICRA Limited. The withdrawal applies to long-term fund-based limits of Rs. 4,000.00 crore, previously rated AAA with a stable outlook, and short-term non-fund-based limits of Rs. 2,050.00 crore, previously rated A1+. The total facilities withdrawn amount to Rs. 6,050.00 crore. ICRA confirmed the withdrawal was at the company's request, based on No Objection Certificates from bankers. The agency stated it has no information suggesting a change in credit risk since the last review. The filing was made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulation, 2015. The notice was issued on 11th November, 2026.

TVSMOTOR.attchmntText: TVS Motor Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 11, 2026, titled "TVS MOTOR EXPANDS ITS GLOBAL PORTFOLIO WITH TVS CALLISTO 110 LAUNCH IN ISTANBUL".
TVSMOTOR.voiceSummary: TVS Motor Company filed a press release on 11th November 2026 regarding the launch of the TVS Callisto 110 scooter in Istanbul. The launch was conducted in partnership with Uğur Motorlu Araçlar. The scooter features a 113.3 cc fuel-injected engine with CVTi automatic transmission. It includes a 33-litre under-seat storage compartment and a starting price of ₺ 132,600. The announcement details technical specifications such as Body Balance Technology and a digital instrument cluster. This filing serves to disseminate information about the product expansion into the Turkish market.

The call, held on November 5, 2026, covered the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company reported record revenue of 10,263 crores, a 24% year-on-year increase. Operating EBITDA was 2,156 crores, up 28% year-on-year, with a margin of 21%. Profit after tax stood at 1,124 crores. Key developments included the completion of the Lannett acquisition and the launch of the ADQUEY product. The company reiterated its FY27 guidance for double-digit revenue growth, EBITDA margins north of 21%, and absolute EBITDA exceeding 8,000 crore. The transcript is available on the company website.

AUROPHARMA.attchmntText: Aurobindo Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange that Apitoria Unit 2, an API manufacturing facility of Apitoria Pharma Private Limited., a subsidiary of the Company, receives Establishment Inspection Report from US FDA with classification as  Voluntary Action Indicated
AUROPHARMA.voiceSummary: Aurobindo Pharma Limited reports that Apitoria Unit 2, an API manufacturing facility of its wholly owned subsidiary Apitoria Pharma Private Limited, received an Establishment Inspection Report from the US FDA. BOSCHLTD.voiceSummary: Bosch Limited filed a transcript of its Investors’ Concall held on November 6, 2026, pursuant to SEBI Regulations 30 and 46(2)(oa). Management reported consolidated revenue from operations of INR76,551 million for July-September 2026, a 28.2% increase over the prior year. EBITDA stood at INR10,371 million, up 23.2%. Profit after tax grew by 18.5% for the quarter. For the six months ending September 2026, revenue grew 25% and EBITDA grew 20.6%. The company reported consolidated revenue of INR6,655 crores, a 38% year-on-year increase. Profit after tax attributable to shareholders grew 38% to INR420 crores. EBITDA rose 33% to INR733 crores with margins at 11%. The casting vertical was the fastest-growing segment, up 57% to INR1,441 crores. Switches revenue reached INR1,609 crores, up 37%, while lighting revenue grew 25% to INR1,381 crores. The company highlighted capacity expansions in alloy wheels and aluminum die casting. Management noted challenging global economic conditions but strong domestic automotive demand in India.

KIMS.voiceSummary: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 FY2027 earnings conference call held on 5th November 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue of INR1,363 crores, an EBITDA of INR279 crores, and a PAT of INR76 crores. Operational highlights included IP volumes of 81,668 and OP volumes of 731,010. TRANSRAILL.attchmntText: Transrail Lighting Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript  of the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
TRANSRAILL.voiceSummary: Transrail Lighting Limited filed a transcript of the earnings call for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, held on November 4, 2026. The company reported revenue of INR2,056 crores for Q2 FY27, a 32% year-on-year increase, with EBITDA at INR238 crores. The order book stood at INR14,218 crores as of September 30, with additional orders of INR1,747 crores declared post-quarter. The Board approved the acquisition of a 49% stake in a project special purpose vehicle for approximately 990-megawatt solar projects in Maharashtra. Tower manufacturing capacity is 1,84,400 metric tons per annum, and conductor capacity is 40,800 kilometers per annum. Net debt was INR143 crores, and operating cash flow for H1 was INR435 crores.
